questions.prompt: For the experiment "roll a fair die", let \(A\) be "even" and \(B\) be "greater than 4". Identify \(A\cap B\) and calculate \(P(A\cap B)\).
questions.answer: The intersection contains outcomes satisfying both descriptions. Here \(A=\{2,4,6\}\), \(B=\{5,6\}\), and \(A\cap B\) is \{6\}. Therefore \[P(A\cap B)=\frac{1}{6}=0.1667.\]
